name: Special-interest clubs
short: A club, a society or a team, travelling for the thing they love most.
summary: Birders, cyclists, photographers, cricket teams and yoga groups, with a trip planned around the thing that brings you together.

image.alt: An elephant at close range on a morning drive

suits.heading: Planned around the reason you travel.
suits.body: We plan the specialist days with people who know them, and the rest of the trip so it does not get in the way.
points: Cricket tours and matches against local clubs

services.heading: What we look after.
services.body: The specialist parts, and everything around them.

items.title: Specialist guides
items.body: Bird guides for Sinharaja and Kumana, cycling support vehicles, a yoga teacher or a cricket fixture secretary.

items.title: Timings that suit
items.body: Dawn starts for birders, rest days for riders, match days for the team.

items.title: Group transport
items.body: A mini coach with room for kit, and a support van for cycling groups.

items.title: Stays that understand
items.body: Lodges near the reserves, hotels with space for bikes, retreats with a shala.

items.title: A leader for the group
items.body: A Travedise tour leader with you throughout, alongside your own club leader.

items.title: Endemic birds
items.body: Sinharaja rainforest, Horton Plains and the dry-zone parks, with a specialist guide.

items.title: Cricket tour
items.body: Fixtures against local clubs in Colombo, Kandy and Galle, with a day at an international ground.

items.title: Hill-country ride
items.body: Supported cycling through tea country, with a van for bags and tired legs.

questions.q: Can you arrange matches against local cricket clubs?
questions.a: Yes. Tell us the standard of your side and the dates, and we approach clubs that will give you a good game.

questions.q: Will the guides know our interest as well as we do?
questions.a: We work with specialist guides for birding, wildlife photography and cycling. For a very specific interest, tell us and we will find the right person.
